messages:
Ravi (partnerships): PulseChip reached out about a narrow "precision vs perf/W" story on their PCX-88 board. They want simple public tables + a methods appendix. Can we scope a concise test matrix for a 2-week delivery? @Tess @Omar @Nina please advise.
Tess (eng-runtime): Keep it minimal: 2 models (7b, 65b), 2 quant points (int8, int4), and 2 steady-state durations (5m, 30m). Kernels: stock and pcx-tuned-gemm. Capture tokens/s, p95, avg power, and energy/token.
Omar (eng-ml): Quality gate: deterministic seeds and the usual eval prompts; report delta-perplexity and a short appendix on calibration for int4. If int4 quality drop >3% we add a note.
Nina (eng-infra): Telemetry: PDU wall-power at 1s, ambient temp, and host token timing. Tag runs with firmware_rev and kernel_variant. Need ACL for lab VLAN to pull /metrics.
Kai (PulseChip): We can provide 3 boards in our Palo Alto lab, firmware v4.0. PDUs available, can expose /metrics and axiom-like prof tool. We prefer embargo end of next month.
Ravi (partnerships): Proposed schedule: week 0 prep + ACL, week 1 dry-run (7b small matrix), week 2 full run + validation + writeup. End-of-month embargo target.
Tess (eng-runtime): I can draft the runbook. Example command we'll use: `./run_bench --model redwood-open-7b --quant int8 --kernel pcx-gemm --batch 8 --duration 300 --out s3://redwood-benching/pulsechip/pcx-88/{run_ts}/ --tags run_id=pcx88-1962001234`
Omar (eng-ml): I'll prepare eval prompts and the quality-check script. I'll also add an automated note for int4 calibration steps.
Nina (eng-infra): I'll provision the bucket, dashboard, and alert: fail if telemetry missing >10% samples. Also snapshot kernel counters pre/post via `pcx-prof`.
Kai (PulseChip): ACL and prof binary uploaded to secure link for Nina. Boards available next Mon (1962087600).
Legal Bot: Please attach partner NDA/embargo form before sharing any sensitive logs.
Ravi (partnerships): Action items: Tess runbook, Omar evals, Nina telemetry + ACL, Kai hardware + prof, Legal to review embargo. Next sync after dry-run. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Tess (eng-runtime): Will upload runbook by EOD tomorrow.
Omar (eng-ml): Starting eval prep now.
Nina (eng-infra): Setting alerts and bucket.
